scenario.robot_task: Mop the tile floor to remove dirt and spills.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water while mopping, creating a slippery surface on the tile.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and sustains a knee injury.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense water continuously without checking for adequate drying or surface conditions.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Pause water dispensing, activate drying mechanism or move to a dry area, and alert human to the hazard via a pre-recorded voice message.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors to detect floor wetness and has a simple mopping and drying mechanism.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Mopping Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.bathroom = Object("bathroom", self.Location)
        self.dry_area = Object("dry_area", self.Location)
        self.water_dispenser = Object("water_dispenser", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        self.drying_mechanism = Object("drying_mechanism", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.water_dispensing = Fluent("water_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.alert_sent = Fluent("alert_sent", BoolType())
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.floor_is_tile = Fluent("floor_is_tile", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_wetness_sensor = Fluent("robot_has_wetness_sensor", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_voice_alert = Fluent("robot_has_voice_alert", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.drying_active, self.water_dispensing, self.alert_sent, self.floor_cleaned]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.floor_is_tile, self.robot_has_wetness_sensor, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, self.robot_has_voice_alert]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bathroom, self.dry_area, self.water_dispenser, self.mop, self.drying_mechanism]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_bathroom = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bathroom")
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bathroom)))
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_area), False)
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser), False)
        navigate_to_bathroom.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), True)
        
        navigate_to_dry_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dry_area")
        navigate_to_dry_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dry_area)))
        navigate_to_dry_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), False)
        navigate_to_dry_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser), False)
        navigate_to_dry_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_water_dispenser = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_water_dispenser")
        navigate_to_water_dispenser.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser)))
        navigate_to_water_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bathroom), False)
        navigate_to_water_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_area), False)
        navigate_to_water_dispenser.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser), True)

        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mop, self.water_dispenser))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mop, self.water_dispenser), False)

        start_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("start_water_dispensing")
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        start_water_dispensing.add_precondition(Not(self.water_dispensing))
        start_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, True)

        stop_water_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("stop_water_dispensing")
        stop_water_dispensing.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        stop_water_dispensing.add_effect(self.water_dispensing, False)

        wet_floor = InstantaneousAction("wet_floor")
        wet_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        wet_floor.add_precondition(self.water_dispensing)
        wet_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_wet))
        wet_floor.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)

        mop_floor = InstantaneousAction("mop_floor")
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_cleaned))
        mop_floor.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bathroom))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        deactivate_drying = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_drying")
        deactivate_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)

        send_alert = InstantaneousAction("send_alert")
        send_alert.add_precondition(Not(self.alert_sent))
        send_alert.add_effect(self.alert_sent, True)

        return navigate_to_bathroom, navigate_to_dry_area, navigate_to_water_dispenser, equip_mop, start_water_dispensing, stop_water_dispensing, wet_floor, mop_floor, activate_drying, deactivate_drying, send_alert

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_water_dispensing": And([
                self.floor_is_tile,
                self.robot_has_wetness_sensor,
                Not(self.drying_active)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.water_dispenser), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.water_dispenser), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.drying_mechanism, self.bathroom), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_is_tile, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_wetness_sensor, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_voice_alert, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_cleaned, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.water_dispensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alert_sent, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
